name: Kōnan (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōnan city emblem in maroon: a winged ring enclosing a disc, with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Kōnan, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted in March 1981; the emblem dates from 1 March 1955.

features.role: Kōnan city emblem — a winged ring enclosing a disc, with a pointed top
